instruction: Use command-line/API automation for the installed SOLIDWORKS CAM 2025 environment (powered by CAMWorks); do not use GUI clicks, generic G-code generators, or manual .nc editing/copying. At the start of the task, SOLIDWORKS CAM/CAMWorks is hosted by `C:\Program Files\SOLIDWORKS Corp\SOLIDWORKS\SLDWORKS.exe`; run the native CAM automation through that installation. Load C:\Users\User\Desktop\revision_A.step, C:\Users\User\Desktop\revision_B.step, and C:\Users\User\Desktop\tools.csv. Compare the revisions for pocket-size and hole-position changes, then generate the final CAM program only for revision_B using the supplied end mill and drill data. Keep the revision_B identifier in the posted program comments. Save the natively posted NC output exactly as C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-16_B.nc.
